targets.authors: Karlsson, H., Mcntyre, S., Gustavson, S., Andersson, D., Szczot, I., Heilig, M. et al.
targets.title: Choice of alcohol over a natural reward: an experimental study in light and heavy social drinkers.
targets.evidence_quote: Our behavioral findings partially replicate previous results, showing that choice preference for alcohol was affected by the relative value of the alternative reward (Hogarth & Hardy,  2018 ; Karlsson et al.,  2024 ).
targets.outcome_quote: Our behavioral findings partially replicate previous results, showing that choice preference for alcohol was affected by the relative value of the alternative reward (Hogarth & Hardy,  2018 ; Karlsson et al.,  2024 ).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly describe their behavioral findings as partially replicating the set of results from both cited papers. Relative-cost sensitivity replicated, while the relation between alcohol use severity and alcohol choice did not. The overall partial-replication verdict applies to both named originals.
